    • paintBackground

      protected void paintBackground(Graphics g, JMenuItem menuItem, Color bgColor)
      The paintBackground method paints the grey tab. The supplied background color is ignored. SshClientTheme.paintMenuTab(Graphics, JMenuItem) does the paint.
      Overrides:
      paintBackground in class BasicMenuItemUI
      Parameters:
      g - The graphics context.
      menuItem - The menu row.
      bgColor - The stock background. This method ignores it.
